feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 26 June 2026 6:16am
items.description:
##Today##

Any showers at first may be heavy and thundery but will soon die out. Then sunny spells in places, but mist and low cloud is likely to develop at times around central and southern parts. Dry overnight, mist in places. Breezy later in day/ overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 15°C and max. air temperature 24°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-5


##Wind Speed##

20


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

Variable 10-15, gradually settling and increasing South 20 through the day, 25 gusts 30-35 in places. Decreasing slightly South 15-20 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling poor or very poor in mist. Extensive hill fog developing.


##Comments##

Strong winds developing in places. Slight thunder risk for the beginning of this period.


##Tomorrow##

Dry with sunny intervals during day, but still some patchy mist/ low cloud possible and quite breezy. Outbreaks of rain later in evening/ overnight.


##Temperature##

##Rainfall (mm):##

1-5


##Wind Speed##

##Wind##

South 15-20, increasing 20-25 in place with gusts of 35, then veering and decreasing SW 10-15 overnight, 15-20 in places.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor or very poor in mist. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds in places until later.
